notes: OWNED: arrived (Andrew, 2026-11-12); it was due 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-10. Ordered by Andrew on Amazon, 2026-11-08, qty 1 (the master bedroom): "I will order now, but record it as ordered." Delivery as the product page showed that day (provisional until his order page says): FREE delivery Tuesday, November 10. In Andrew's Amazon cart, qty 1 (2026-11-08, read only; the cart line matches the variant and size recorded here). Flags: assumed-position:window (F-38). The master bedroom's pair (F-43, F-68 (9)). Andrew, 2026-11-08, of the 52" H.VERSAILTEX: "Why are you suggestin 52" width? isn't that too narrow?", then "master rod is about 75". is it OK?" It wasn't: 2 x 52" = 104" on a 75" rod is 1.39x, under the 1.5x minimum. Fit: 2 x 66" = 132" on the 75" rod = 1.76x, inside the 1.5 to 2x range: deep waves and a few inches of overlap where the panels meet, and with 8 grommets a panel still stacks to about a foot when open. 54" long on 1.6" grommets, the rod 2 to 3" above the 50" window: they end at the sill, clear of the heater (F-33); the grommets slide on a rod up to about 1 1/2" · fits. Color: Sea Teal, a deep muted teal (the listing's Teal is a bright turquoise; Navy is near black; Sage Green and Stone Blue are on the same listing), between the blue and the green of the teal/green/blue bedding and a classic match for the brown-walnut RÅDMANSÖ. Light: triple weave, not lined: "Curtains impede 85%-99% light and UV ray(Darker colors more better)"; a dark teal sits at the high end, and on a 75" rod the leaks that show are at the edges and the middle, which the width closes. "machine washable"; "thermal insulated". Read 2026-11-08: $33.24 (5 percent off; $16.62 per count), "Only 8 left in stock - order soon.", FREE delivery Tuesday, November 10; 4.6 stars (51,259, the listing's); Amazon's Choice on the listing. rooms: master-bedroom, from Andrew.
